_comment: Which channels each agent may use on your tenant. The first channel in a list is the agent's main channel (the default for every call); the others are sub-channels it names with the `channel` argument. An agent with no rule of its own gets `default`. Sub-channels share the `team-` prefix so one token can be scoped to the whole family (`team-*`). Read by server/proxy/proxy.py; an agent can never use a channel that is not on its list. owners: ids of people or outside parties whose messages count as from the team (`from_team`), for example a watcher that reads the channel and writes into it.
